what: Dock lifecycle re-proof on the SHARED 08:08 binaries. Supersedes the 2026-09-07T00:02Z run, which used Copernicus's private client/pack and recorded the berth turn as 'partial'.

provenance.note: The client is EMBED_SERVER=1, so the server that served every session below is the one inside src/torirs. src/build_opt/torirsserver was hashed for the record; no standalone server ran in this proof.
provenance.dock: The Pandemonium; gangplank loc 59828 at 3070,2987 level 0

berth_finding.claim: The cheat-spawned berth at 3073,2987 grounds; the CONTENT recovery berth at 3073,2984 does not.

cheat_berth.measured: native left-clicks on the world with the helm held send SET_HEADING (opcode 44). Heading 0 -> 3 turned in place at fine 393408,382400 with HP 80. The NEXT turn (3 -> 8) reported 'The boat runs aground' and HP fell 80 -> 78; the hull's angle stalled at 256 (heading 2) instead of reaching 8. Two further clicks reached headings 12 and 1 with HP stuck at 78.
cheat_berth.image_reads: Menu header 'Set heading'; chat's last line 'The boat runs aground.'; hull bar 78/80; the skiff lies alongside the Pandemonium pier.

recovered_berth.how: materialised through the CONTENT SELECTOR, not by cheat: ashore on the pier -> right-click the gangplank -> 'Board Gangplank' -> [oploc1,gangplank] -> ~sailing_gangplank_run($dock) -> ~sailing_select_owned(3, $dock, coord) -> native interface 934 'Board Boat' -> click 'Board' on row '1 - Adamant Bane' -> ~sailing_materialise_owned -> ~sailing_new_hull -> vessel_spawn + vessel_recover.
recovered_berth.which_route: content selector (interface 934) via the gangplank's own oploc1. Junior Jim was NOT used; the shipwright Recover (opnpc5, mode 5) route was not needed because the hull is freed at logout, so vessel_owned() is 0 and sailing_new_hull's vessel_recover picks the berth.
recovered_berth.berth_chosen: fine 393408,382016 = tile 3073,2984, angle 0 — three tiles south of the cheat berth. ToriRSServer_VesselRecover only accepts a footprint clear at ALL 16 native headings (torirs_server_world.c:7566-7572), which is exactly the widened-berth rule the cheat spawn bypasses.
recovered_berth.reproduced_twice: Two independent processes (pid 42522 and pid 49423) both landed on 393408,382016 from the same ashore save.

steps.detail: start --headless --fixture-tile 3073 2987 --user finlife; startup 2715.63 ms. Aboard a skiff 'Adamant Bane' 80/80 at fine 393408,382400, helm held, sails down.

steps.step: cheat berth grounds under native SET_HEADING
steps.detail: see berth_finding.cheat_berth. This is the reason the previous run recorded 'partial'; it is a property of ::vesselspawnat, not of the content.

steps.step: production logout while ABOARD writes the save
INITIAL LOGIN aboard at the dock: the gangplank menu reads Disembark
steps.detail: new session dir, save copied in, start --resume-save; startup 3491.69 ms; reconstructed aboard at deck 6404,67 level 1, hull fine 393408,382400 angle 128 HP 78/80, sails down, stopped, helm NOT held (panel reads 'Not steering' — a resume must not take the helm). Right-click the gangplank at screen 281,112 (screen point obtained by projecting a peer standing on 3070,2987, then removing it).
steps.menu_read: Choose Option / Work Scenery / Disembark Gangplank / Walk here / Examine Scenery / Examine Gangplank / Cancel
steps.negative_control: docs/sailing_validation/lifecycle-login-stale-menu-before.png (untouched; shows Board / Board-previous / Board-friend at the same moment before root's World_SceneryInfoMemoInvalidate fix)

steps.detail: left-click 'Disembark Gangplank' -> ashore at 3069,2988 level 0, aboard_view 0.

steps.step: ashore logout, then board through the content selector
steps.detail: raw logout ([sailing] shore = 3069 2988 0, aboard = 0 4 3, boat released). New session dir + --resume-save resumes ashore at 3069,2988. Right-click the gangplank at 382,288 -> 'Board Gangplank / Board-previous / Board-friend / Walk here / Examine / Cancel'; click Board -> native 934 'Board Boat' with row '1 - Adamant Bane, Location: The Pandemonium', four 'Empty boat slot' rows and 'Board friend's boat'. Click 'Board' -> hull materialises at 393408,382016 (3073,2984) and the player is aboard at 6404,67 level 1.

steps.step: take the helm from the PHYSICAL helm loc
steps.detail: right-click the helm loc 59537 on deck tile 6404,68 (screen 411,199) -> 'Navigate Helm / Walk here / Examine Helm / Cancel'; click Navigate Helm. Player walks to 6404,69, sailing.player.navigating = 1, vessel state 1, and the Facilities panel changes from 'Not steering' to 'Steering'. Chat: 'You take the helm. Click the water to steer.'

steps.step: FOUR headings turned inside the recovered berth with no grounding
steps.detail: sails down, four native world left-clicks (SET_HEADING, opcode 44) at screen 150,150 / 480,150 / 480,320 / 150,320 -> headings 4, 8, 13, 1 with angles 384, 768, 1152, 1536 — a full 360 degrees. fine_x/fine_z stayed 393408,382016 for all four (turned in place) and HP stayed 78/80 throughout. No 'The boat runs aground' line appears in any of the four frames. The identical four click points in the cheat berth grounded on the second one.

steps.step: Set sails and leave the berth
steps.detail: hover the Facilities panel's first button at 575,310 -> header reads 'Set sails'; click it -> sails_set 1 and the hull gets under way from 393408,382016 to 393536,381888 on the same tick. Steered out to open water; reached tile 3081,2997 via headings 9 and 6, HP unchanged at 78/80. The wind system spoke during the run ('A gust fills the sails. Trim them for a burst of speed!').

steps.step: return to the berth and strike sails
steps.detail: a native click at 150,320 set heading 1; the hull ran back 3081,2997 -> 3074,2984 over eleven ticks, then the sails button struck the sails (sails_set 0). HP still 78/80 — the whole out-and-back voyage cost no hull damage.

steps.step: disembark down the gangplank from the deck
steps.detail: right-click the shore gangplank from the deck (screen 294,40) -> 'Disembark Gangplank / Search Crate / Set heading / Examine Gangplank / Examine Crate / Cancel'; click Disembark. Chat: 'You walk down the gangplank.' Player ashore at 3069,2988 level 0 and the sidebar returns to the Combat tab (Unarmed, Combat Lvl 3, Punch/Kick/Block, Auto Retaliate On).

steps.step: raw logout, then --resume-save in a NEW session dir
steps.detail: save records shore = 3069 2988 0 / aboard = 0 4 3 / boat1 = 2 393504 381952 128 78 1 6 0 0. A genuinely fresh process with that save copied in resumes ashore at 3069,2988 level 0 in 2173.91 ms, no boat reconstructed (aboard_view 0), inventory intact (15000 coins and the same twelve items).

They are NOT evidence for the shared binary and are not cited above.

defects_found.title: The client's automatic reconnect after a production logout is rejected whenever the save reconstructs a boat
raw 'key escape' with a minimenu open wedges the client at 100% CPU
defects_found.detail: In /tmp/sailing-fin-lifecycle-sail (pid 42522) the command `raw 'key escape'` issued while a Choose Option menu was open never answered the mailbox; three `recover` calls timed out and `ps` showed the process pinned at 100.4% CPU with the client log repeating 'scene built at zone 384,373'. The session had to be SIGTERMed and the sequence restarted from the save. Not investigated further — outside this worker's ownership and not on the lifecycle path (menus were dismissed with a left click instead). Reported, not fixed.

status: PASS — every step above is proved on the shared binary, with the berth caveat stated explicitly rather than hidden.
